Project  activities  include  several  models  that  land  owners  select  from,  including  agroforestry,  commercial  reforestation  stands,  silvopastoral  systems,  mixed  forest  systems,  and  assisted  natural  regeneration,  in  an  area  of  4,538.7  hectares.  Project  activities  are  developed  in  areas  whose  uses  have  been  and  will  continue  to  be,  in  the  absence  of  this  project,  traditional  extensive cattle grazing and coffee (Coffea arabica) cultivation, mainly in unshaded monoculture. The purpose and scope of verification involve documental review, on-site visit, interviews, consultation  of secondary information sources, findings statements, feedback with the project owner and elaboration  of the final report. In order to carry out the verification, Verified Carbon Standard Program Guidelines  dated  8  October  2013  were  taken  into  account  and  following  the  guidance  provided  in  the  VCS  Validation and Verification Manual, in addition to requirements set out in ISO 14064-3:2006.  During the verification, the ICONTEC team identified 13 findings (7 Clarification Requests, 6 Corrective  Action  Request)  that  were  addressed  satisfactorily  by  the  project  proponent  during  the  verification  process  to  ensure  that  the  MR  fulfills  the  VCS  program  requirements  for  GHG  projects  and  the  registered PD. management tools, including development of mini-corridors, expansion of stream protection margins, 
protection of water sources and wetlands, enrichment of isolated forests units, connections between natural 
forest fragments and revegetation of erosion-prone areas.

- Interconnection of forest ecosystems  
- Isolating and buffering wetland areas 
- Restoring the forestry margins of streams which have lost their vegetation 
- Restoring the areas surrounding the wetlands.

:  | : The primary objective of the project is to regulate and improve the quantity and quality of freshwater for  the region’s communities by restoring the watersheds that supply their water systems, specifically the  Chinchiná  River  watershed.  Project  activities  include  several  models  that  land  owners  select  from,  including  agroforestry,  commercial  reforestation  stands,  silvopastoral  systems,  mixed  forest  systems,  and  assisted  natural  regeneration,  in  an  area  of  4,538.7  hectares.  Project  activities  are  developed  in  areas  whose  uses  have  been  and  will  continue  to  be,  in  the  absence  of  this  project,  traditional  extensive cattle grazing and coffee (Coffea arabica) cultivation, mainly in unshaded monoculture.  ICONTEC was contracted by INFIMANIZALES to conduct the project verification. The verification process  was  intended  to  assess  the  conformance  of  the  project  with  the  VCS  rules  and  the  methodology  applied to the project. This verification includes the planted area (2,030.38 hectares).  The  Monitoring  Report  and  supporting  documents  were  designed  to  conform  to  the  VCS  Standard  v.3.5, specifically as an ARR project under the AFOLU project types (AFOLU Requirements VCS v.3).  For the first monitoring period,  the project applied the approved CDM Afforestation and Reforestation  methodology:  Consolidated  Methodology  Afforestation  and  AR-ACM0003  “A/R  Large-scale  Reforestation of lands except wetlands” - Version 02.0.  The purpose and scope of verification involve documental review, on-site visit, interviews, consultation  of secondary information sources, findings statements, feedback with the project owner and elaboration  of the final report. In order to carry out the verification, Verified Carbon Standard Program Guidelines  dated  8  October  2013  were  taken  into  account  and  following  the  guidance  provided  in  the  VCS  Validation and Verification Manual, in addition to requirements set out in ISO 14064-3:2006.  During the verification, the ICONTEC team identified 13 findings (7 Clarification Requests, 6 Corrective  Action  Request)  that  were  addressed  satisfactorily  by  the  project  proponent  during  the  verification  process  to  ensure  that  the  MR  fulfills  the  VCS  program  requirements  for  GHG  projects  and  the  registered PD. No CARs that could lead to a material discrepancy between the project and the project  description were identified.  Documentation  review,  interviews  and  on-site  visit  allowed  ICONTEC  to  collect  enough  evidences  to  completely assess the verification criteria and determinate that the project is implemented according to  the validated and registered PD (Version May 04, 2015). Removals were correctly calculated, based on  the  applied  methodology.  Planted  areas  and  the  monitoring  system  are  in  place  and  followed  appropriately.  ICONTEC  can  confirm  that  the  GHG  emission  reductions/removals  are  calculated  without material misstatements.
